author: Tumasyan, Armen and others
title: Measurement of the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay properties and search for the $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay in proton-proton collisions at $\\sqrt{s} = 13$ TeV
abstract: Measurements are presented of the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ branching fraction and effective lifetime, as well as results of a search for the $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay in proton-proton collisions at $\\sqrt{s} = 13$ TeV at the LHC. The analysis is based on data collected with the CMS detector in 2016-2018 corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb$^{-1}$. The branching fraction of the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay and the effective $B_s^0$ meson lifetime are the most precise single measurements to date. No evidence for the $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decay has been found. All results are found to be consistent with the standard model predictions and previous measurements.
